parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of vpc peering connection.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: local_vpc_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of local VPC.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the VPC peering connection. The value can contain 1 to 64 characters.

parameters.name: peering_vpc
parameters.description: Specifies information about the peering VPC.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the project which the peering vpc belongs to.

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of peering VPC.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeouts
parameters.description: The timeouts for each operations. Default: {}

parameters.name: create
parameters.description: The timeouts for create operation. Default: "15m"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
# create a peering connect
- name: Create a local vpc
  hwc_network_vpc:
    cidr: "192.168.0.0/16"
    name: "ansible_network_vpc_test_local"
  register: vpc1
- name: Create a peering vpc
  hwc_network_vpc:
    cidr: "192.168.0.0/16"
    name: "ansible_network_vpc_test_peering"
  register: vpc2
- name: Create a peering connect
  community.general.hwc_vpc_peering_connect:
    local_vpc_id: "{{ vpc1.id }}"
    name: "ansible_network_peering_test"
    peering_vpc:
      vpc_id: "{{ vpc2.id }}"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: The description of vpc peering connection. Returned: success

return_values.name: local_vpc_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of local VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Specifies the name of the VPC peering connection. The value can contain 1 to 64 characters. Returned: success

return_values.name: peering_vpc
return_values.description: Specifies information about the peering VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: project_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of the project which the peering vpc belongs to. Returned: success

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of peering VPC. Returned: success
